legal_privacy_intro: Under Art. 13 GDPR we explain which personal data we process when you use adoptierlieber.de.
legal_privacy_controller_text: The controller for data processing on this website is the company named in the imprint.
legal_privacy_hosting_text: The website and API run on Cloudflare (Cloudflare, Inc., 101 Townsend St, San Francisco, CA 94107, USA). Cloudflare operates Workers, the D1 database, R2 object storage and KV for us. Transfers to the USA rely on Standard Contractual Clauses and the EU-US Data Privacy Framework where Cloudflare is certified.
legal_privacy_account_text: On registration we store your name, optional display name, email address, a hashed password and an optional profile picture. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (contract / pre-contractual steps). The picture is stored in R2. Account data is kept until you delete the account or ask us to erase it.
legal_privacy_cookie_text: After sign-in we set the sessionToken cookie. It is httpOnly, SameSite=Lax and Secure in production. It holds a session identifier, not your password. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR. The cookie is required for the account; without it you stay signed out. It expires with the session or when you log out.
legal_privacy_contact_text: If you write via the contact form we process name, email and message to answer you (Art. 6(1)(b) or (f) GDPR). A hidden field is only a bot trap; filled traps are discarded unread. We delete enquiries once handled, unless a legal retention duty applies.
legal_privacy_mail_text: We send email to verify your address, reset your password and confirm account deletion. This is required to run the account (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
legal_privacy_shelter_text: In addition to the account we store the organisation name, address, optional website, registry number and description. We review shelters manually. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR.
legal_privacy_analytics_text: We currently do not use analytics, tracking or advertising cookies and do not build advertising profiles.
legal_privacy_rights_text: You have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, data portability and to object to processing based on Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. You may also lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority. For us that includes the State Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information of North Rhine-Westphalia (LDI NRW), Kavalleriestraße 2–4, 40213 Düsseldorf, Germany.
